prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. Paragraph p0 reads "START BODY 1 The quick, brown fox jumps over a lazy dog. END BODY 1.". Apply both edits in a single command invocation: (1) replace "brown" with "red" and (2) replace "lazy" with "energetic". Both anchors occur once in p0. Write the result to {output}. Use --author {author} for the new edits. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} reads "START BODY 1 The quick, red fox jumps over an energetic dog. END BODY 1." with both replacements visible; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Both edits applied as one plan invocation; no half-applied state.
